sidetone.label: Hear yourself
sidetone.desc-toggle: Sidetone: feeds your mic back into the earcups. This headset supports on/off only, not a level.
sidetone.desc-slider: Sidetone: feeds your mic back into the earcups. 0 turns it off.

inactive-time.label: Auto power-off
inactive-time.desc: Switch the headset off after this long with no audio, to save battery.

panel.no-controls: This headset reports no adjustable settings.
panel.waiting: Waiting for headsetcontrol to report the device...
panel.write-only-note: The headset cannot report these settings back, so the values shown are the last ones applied from here.

hide-when-offline.label: Hide when headset is off
hide-when-offline.desc: Remove the widget from the bar while the headset is powered down or disconnected.

poll-interval.label: Poll interval
poll-interval.desc: How often to ask the headset for its battery level.

low-threshold.label: Low battery threshold
low-threshold.desc: Colour the widget as low battery at or below this level.
